items.title: From Addresses to Efficient Deliveries: Solving Vehicle Routing Problems with Python
items.summary: Presented at XtremePython 2026.This talk explores how Python can connect GIS, traffic data, mathematical optimization, driver constraints, and physical cargo packing into a practical delivery-planning workflow.The demo combines OpenStreetMap, TomTom traffic data, Google OR-Tools, driver schedules and qualifications, customer delivery time windows, truck weight and volume limits, and 3D packing with py3dbp.It also demonstrates an iterative approach in which routing is re-optimized when an assigned truck load fails the physical packing check, and compares the use of commercial traffic data with public/open transportation data from Irvine GIS and Caltrans.XtremePython 2026:https://xtremepython.dev/2026/speakers/
